issue: Bypass of Profile Restrictions & Access Zone Control via Compact Mode `execute_tool`
recommendation: Modify `ExecuteToolTool` (and `BatchExecuteTool` at `compact.rs:467`) to route calls through `call_tool_in_profile` rather than directly invoking `call_tool` on the aggregator. Ensure that the active profile and caller's access zone clearance (via IP-based `ToolGroups` verification) are checked before proxying tool executions.

issue: Denial of Service (DoS) via Cache Write-Lock Contention on Every Read
recommendation: Replace the `RwLock<LruCache>` pattern with a lock-free or concurrent-safe caching library (e.g., `moka` or sharded concurrent maps) that can update access history without acquiring an exclusive asynchronous write-lock on the entire cache.

issue: Gaps in Schema-as-Code & OSCAL Compliance for Tool Data Contracts
recommendation: Replace ad-hoc `json!` macros and structural configuration types with formalized, version-controlled Protocol Buffers or structured machine-readable OSCAL profiles. Ensure all dynamically retrieved upstream tool contracts are validated against these versioned schemas.

issue: Silent Failures and Partial Implementation of Stdio Upstream Transport
recommendation: Fully implement child-process spawning and stdio stream piping for `TransportType::Stdio`. Alternatively, reject configuration parsing of stdio transport options at compile/initialization time with a descriptive error instead of silently succeeding during `initialize` and failing on invocation.

issue: Non-Thread-Safe Dynamic Environment Resolution causing Potential Data Races
recommendation: Resolve all configuration environment variables once at load-time within `AggregatorConfig::load` instead of calling `std::env::var` dynamically on worker threads. Eliminate `std::env::set_var` calls in tests to prevent undefined behavior (UB) in multithreaded test runs.
